openEuler is an open-source, Linux-based operating system project initiated by Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. and now incubated and operated by the OpenAtom Foundation, officially launched on December 31, 2019. Designed as a stable, secure, and high-performance platform, openEuler serves as a foundational operating system for enterprise computing, cloud environments, edge computing, server infrastructure, and embedded systems. It supports multiple processor architectures, including x86_64, aarch64 (ARM64), RISC-V, Kunpeng, Phytium, and Zen, enabling broad hardware compatibility and reflecting its commitment to an inclusive, architecture-agnostic ecosystem. The project is built on the Linux kernel, with specific versions such as 4.19.90 used in certain iterations, and fosters a community-driven development model with transparent governance, Special Interest Groups (SIGs), committer and maintainer roles, and public release mechanisms.

openEuler provides long-term support (LTS) releases, including openEuler 20.03-LTS (SP1–SP4), 22.03-LTS (SP1, SP2, SP3), and 24.03-LTS (SP1, SP2, SP3), which are widely deployed in cloud-native platforms, virtual machines, data centers, and enterprise-grade applications. These versions are tailored for stability, security, and reliability, making them suitable for container environments, system-level testing, and large-scale deployments. The platform is promoted as a migration target for legacy systems running CentOS, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), and similar distributions, supported by tools like x2openEuler for streamlined upgrades. It features robust software package management via YUM and DNF, with signed RPM packages verified using the RPM-GPG-KEY-openEuler, and repositories hosted on official mirrors like repo.openeuler.openatom.cn, as well as mirrors from Huawei Cloud and Tsinghua University.

The system includes advanced functionality such as minimal installation modes, security enhancements—including PAM_wheel.so enforcement—default GRUB credentials (root/openEuler#12), and hardware compatibility testing via oec-hardware. It integrates system-level software such as SysMaster, the iSulad container runtime, and Euler-Copilot, and supports critical operations like IPSec/VPN configuration, driver installation, and software compilation. openEuler is utilized in diverse domains, including AI development, real-time operating system integration (e.g., with UniProton), embedded devices, system diagnostics, and deployment of databases like MySQL and OpenGauss. It supports software components such as Zabbix, Atlas 200 drivers, ROS2 Humble, and hardware platforms like LeapFive InFive Poros and VisionFive development boards.

The project plays a central role in China’s information technology innovation (xinchuang) initiative and is widely adopted across government, finance, transportation, energy, education, and communications sectors. It has achieved over 3 million installations and holds more than 25% market share in new Chinese server operating systems. OpenEuler continues to expand its global presence, documented on DistroWatch, and maintains active community engagement through technical forums, internships, documentation, and open contribution channels. While it faces certain challenges—including limited support for snapd, absence of EPEL, missing package compatibility with some CentOS tools, and known issues such as kernel bugs affecting UDP transmission—its ecosystem grows rapidly, with initiatives like open-eBackup, secGear for confidential computing, the Gazelle networking stack, and the COPR repository. It is also the foundation for tools such as EulerMaker and Eggops for Kubernetes deployment. Despite minor installation limitations and dependency management complexities, openEuler stands as a robust, adaptable, and innovative open-source platform, symbolizing a major advancement in China's open-source software landscape.<SEP>openEuler is a Linux-based open-source operating system designed for enterprise use.<SEP>openEuler is a Linux-based open-source operating system designed for enterprise use.<SEP>openEuler is an open-source operating system project under the Linux Foundation, targeted by the HCIA certification.<SEP>openEuler is an open-source operating system project focused on server, cloud, and edge computing, released as part of the OpenEuler community.

EUR hosts Python packages via a PyPI-compatible interface, expanding its utility for Python-based application development and enabling broader ecosystem integration.

It is utilized for installing and managing packages such as i3wm and related components on openEuler systems, highlighting its role in supporting diverse software environments. Additionally, EUR is employed as a build system to construct software packages, notably including ocl-icd, demonstrating its versatility across different technical domains.

我们很高兴您加入社区论坛。openEuler 社区论坛是由 openEuler 社区开发者、用户、合作伙伴一起建立的分享、学习平台。在这里，我们可以自由发声，互相协助解决问题。论坛参与者完全出自他们热爱 openEuler 社区，并且愿意利用工作之余的时间到访社区，并为大家提供帮助。论坛没有任何商业服务支持或响应保证，对于需要更具体的专业知识或在周末或假期提出的问题，可能需要一些耐心。

1 基本原则

我们鼓励互助、互动，但请保持友善交流，不可进行人身攻击，尊重社区的任何一个成员，讨论问题时请尽量做到有理有据，请尽量提供合理的回复来说服别人，切勿令冲突升级。

请规范使用规范使用用户名、头像、个人资料和签名，不得冒充 openEuler 官方人员身份，不得使用容易引起混淆的名称、头像和内容发布信息。

提问之前，搜索一下，发帖寻求帮助前请先搜索，避免偏离主题、交叉发帖和重复发帖。

遵守应法律法规，避免宗教、政治或其他不恰当的言论，禁止钓鱼、滥发消息、骚扰或造谣等行为。

请勿灌水、发广告、刷屏等 openEuler 社区成员都不喜欢的行为。

2 参与论坛讨论

在您学习、测试、调研、开发或者以其他方式使用 openEuler 及相关项目时 ，你可能会遇到一些问题，openEuler 社区论坛的分类中，有一些分类介绍和描述，如果您不确定在哪里发布主题，请选择你觉得最合适的类别，一些常见的问题如：

从其他操作系统迁移到openEuler上（https://forum.openeuler.org/c/migrate/10）

其他技术问题

交流互助区

3 求助注意事项

【在提问前】
在你准备要通过群组或论坛提出技术问题前，请先自己尝试通过各种手段搜索答案，包括但不限于：

openEuler社区技术文档

技术白皮书

【在提问时】
问题要详细，背景信息要全面
请先表明您已经尝试过的方法；这将有助于树立您并不是一个不劳而获且浪费别人的时间的提问者。在社区里提问或者发起相关技术话题讨论是被鼓励的，但是提问也是一门艺术，需要提问者好好把握。

请按照主题模板尽可能详细、清晰、正确、精简地描述你的问题。

无效的问题，往往浪费大家的时间去阅读和理解，并且可能没有人去给你解答。

请给问题起一个准确的标题，以及选择其正确的分类、标签。

提问时要有一定的礼貌，尤其通过社区向个人提问时至关重要。不管问题最终是否得到解答，都能够表示感谢。客气一点肯定会增加您得到有用回应的机会。

描述问题时候，请按照： 【 openEuler 版本 】22.03 LTS /22.03 LTS SP1/xxx【问题现象及影响】 【复现路径】做过哪些操作出现的问题 【资源配置】 描述，尽可能提供更多有效的背景信息，很多问题在不同的场景、业务下，大家可能提供的建议是不一样的，没有讲清楚只会让大家想帮忙都无从下手
【在提问后】
如果您的问题已经获得解决，那么您需要：
对问题选择【最佳答案】，这样子你的问题才能算【已解决】
只有选择了【最佳答案】的问题，才能被搜索到，这样子也能帮助他人更高效地找到答案。
我们不希望论坛出现很多已经解决但是又不进行“已解决”标志的问题。
对解答者表达感谢，因为任何人都没有义务必须帮你解决你的问题。
如果你的问题还没有解决，请继续追问及反馈你遇到的问题，最好能附上操作提示或者截图。
【对以下行为说不】
参与社区互动其实也是一个社交活动，需要个人把握社交分寸，遵守基本的社交礼仪，不可接受的参与者行为包括但不限于：

讨论问题上升到人身攻击，挑衅、侮辱或贬低性评论；

公开或私下骚扰；

未经允许发布他人私人信息；

未经允许发布广告或者其它不良信息；

无故刷屏刷帖从而占用公共资源等。

如违反以上社区公约，版主或管理员将有权处理：
出现第一次，【警告】并进行扣除50积分、50经验值处理
